description: Simulated equipment monitoring data: a vibration time series (80 time steps) and a thermal image (32 x 32 pixels, °C) per sample, the health status (0 = Normal, 1 = Warning, 2 = Critical), and the hidden levels of each sample (column 0 = thermal level, column 1 = vibration level; 0 = fine, 1 = moderate, 2 = severe).
